chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who said:
Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: 'Drinking cold water is a greater enjoyment.'

key_terms.تَلَذُّذ: Enjoyment, pleasure, relishing — used here to affirm a natural human delight
key_terms.شُرْبُ الْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ: Drinking cold water — referenced in the context of recommended practices and physical enjoyment

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say about drinking cold water in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam Abu al-Hasan (most likely al-Kazim, peace be upon him) made a brief statement affirming that drinking cold water brings greater pleasure. This narration appears in the chapter on the merits of drinking water abundantly, contextualizing it within Islamic etiquette of food and drink. The chain of transmission is highly reliable, featuring some of the most celebrated narrators in the Shia tradition.
